title: The Fastest Animal on Earth Is Smaller Than a Sesame Seed

scenes.text: The fastest animal on Earth is a mite smaller than a sesame seed.
It lives in Southern California and runs 322 body lengths every second.
If you ran that fast for your size, you'd hit 1,300 miles an hour.
That's faster than the speed of sound.
Fastest for its size, and it's smaller than a seed.

description:
The fastest animal on Earth is a mite smaller than a sesame seed.
The Southern California mite Paratarsotomus macropalpis was clocked at 322 body lengths per second, about 20 times the cheetah's relative speed.
Which tiny animal do you think would win a race?
thumbnail_text: FASTEST ANIMAL IS SMALLER THAN A SEED
first_comment: Bonus: it is only about 0.7 mm long. Would you have guessed a mite?
